# SpinPickOnline — Complete Platform & Technical Reference

> SpinPickOnline (https://www.spinpickonline.com) is a comprehensive, client-side web application offering provably fair random selection tools. The suite includes custom interactive spinning wheels, virtual 3D dice rollers, physical coin flippers, party bottle spinners, tournament draw generators, and balanced squad creators. Built with Next.js, HTML5 Canvas, and the Web Crypto API, all operations execute entirely in the user's browser with zero server data storage.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Value Proposition

- **100% Free Forever**: No paywalls, subscription fees, feature limits, or forced user registration.
- **Cryptographic Fairness**: Driven by `window.crypto.getRandomValues()` providing uniform discrete pseudo-random distribution with zero predictable bias.
- **Privacy & Security First**: All participant names, entries, scores, and wheel histories remain strictly in client-side memory or HTML5 `localStorage`. Names are never sent to a remote database.
- **Universal Device Compatibility**: Fully responsive layout optimized for mobile smartphones (iOS/Android), tablets, interactive whiteboards (Smartboards), and desktop computers.
- **Shareable State & Embeddable**: Encodes wheel configurations directly into lightweight URLs (`?share=...`) or responsive HTML `<iframe>` snippets for Notion, WordPress, and custom websites.
- **Bulk Import with Deduplication**: Supports pasting hundreds of names directly from spreadsheet columns (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV) or raw text.

---

## 2. Core Interactive Wheels

### Homepage Wheel
- **URL**: https://www.spinpickonline.com

## 10. Technical Architecture & Developer Reference

### 1. Random Number Generation (RNG) Fairness
SpinPickOnline utilizes the browser's native Web Cryptography API rather than standard `Math.random()`, eliminating algorithmic bias:

```typescript
export function getSecureRandom(): number {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.crypto) {
    const array = new Uint32Array(1);
    window.crypto.getRandomValues(array);
    return array[0] / (0xffffffff + 1);
  }
  return Math.random(); // Fallback for legacy environments
}
```

The probability $P$ of any segment $E_i$ being selected on a wheel of $N$ segments is strictly uniform:
$$P(E_i) = \frac{1}{N}$$

### 2. URL Sharing Schema
Custom wheels can be shared without backend storage by encoding state into base64url JSON query parameters:
`https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel?share=<encoded_payload>`

The decoded JSON payload contains:
```json
{
  "wheelName": "Classroom Quiz Team 4",
  "entries": [
    { "id": "1", "label": "Alice", "color": "#3b82f6" },
    { "id": "2", "label": "Bob", "color": "#ef4444" }
  ],
  "results": []
}
```

### 3. Responsive HTML Iframe Embed Code
Webmasters, bloggers, and Notion users can embed an ad-free interactive wheel with zero configuration:
```html
<iframe
  src="https://www.spinpickonline.com/wheel"
  width="100%"
  height="650"
  style="border:none;border-radius:16px;max-width:800px;width:100%;"
  title="SpinPickOnline Random Picker Wheel"
  allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write"
></iframe>
```
